label: Relaxing every arc in rounds
subgoals: Initialize the source to 0 and every other vertex to infinity
Relax every arc once per round
Run n - 1 rounds to reach the final distances

label: Arc order and early termination
subgoals: Note that a relaxation can use a value lowered in the same round
Stop when a full round changes nothing
Relax only arcs out of vertices whose distance changed

label: Negative cycles
subgoals: Test whether any arc still relaxes after n - 1 rounds
Follow predecessor pointers to recover the negative cycle
Report the cycle's constraints as the conflicting set
